journey.name: Download Execution and My Files
journey.description: Tests starting a download from the quality picker, verifying that the download notification and progress bar appear, and confirming the completed file is listed in My Files.

actions.action: Ensure the Quality Picker dialog is open with format options
Tap the desired quality format option (e.g. 720p HD or MP3)
Verify that the quality dialog dismisses and a confirmation toast or banner is displayed
Tap the "My Files" tab in the bottom navigation bar
Verify that the app navigates to the My Files screen
Verify that the active download appears with its title, progress bar, and speed indicator
Wait for the download to complete
Verify that the finished file appears in the completed downloads list with file size and media thumbnail
